subject: Tiered expansion plan + temporary rate freeze request
messages:
From: Jules Martin <contracts@peregrinelabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@peregrinelabs.com>, Marcus Dobson <marcus.dobson@peregrinelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scale path + temporary rate freeze for Q4

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team is excited about the latency profile and the embedding quality. We expect to ramp from ~120M tokens/month to ~600M tokens/month over the next 6 months as we onboard two new product lines.

Before we finalize the internal approvals, procurement asked whether Redwood can offer a short-term rate freeze (90 days) at the current blended rate while we commit to a tiered uplift schedule (commits + capacity credits) that locks in increased spend across the year. The ask is to protect us from any near-term price movement while we prove production usage.

Attached is a one-page scale plan from our product org. Can you let me know what level of temporary protection and credit structure you can support and whether legal would accept a 90-day addendum instead of a full-term amendment up front?

We can loop in finance and legal on our side after an initial outline.

Appreciate it —
Jules
Contracts | Peregrine Labs
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jules Martin <contracts@peregrinelabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scale path + temporary rate freeze for Q4

Hi Jules —

Great to hear the ramp looks substantive. We can support a temporary rate freeze for 90 days paired with a tiered commit schedule and staged credits, subject to a short addendum and a minimum uplift commitment. High-level proposal: 

- 90-day rate freeze at current blended rate (applies to base generation + embedding tokens)
- Tiered commit: 3 levels tied to monthly token bands (250M, 450M, 650M) with stepped unit discounts as volumes cross bands
- Ramp credits: one-time onboarding credit that scales with first-month usage (up to 15% of that month’s invoice)
- Auto-roll: if usage hits the top band for two consecutive months within the 90-day window, the rate freeze converts into a 12-month pricehold at the negotiated band rate

I’m attaching a brief outbound proposal and a draft SOW for legal to review. I’ll need procurement to confirm billing contacts and whether they require PO-based invoicing.

If that structure sounds workable, Karthik can run the economics and Ben can prepare the formal addendum for your legal. Can we sync for 30 minutes tomorrow?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: PL-Scale-Path-Proposal-v1.pdf, Redwood-SOW-draft.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: internal econs for Peregrine — 90d freeze + tiers

Team — quick notes on the economics if we accept the proposed structure: 

- 90-day freeze is low-risk if paired with minimum uplift: recommend a committed uplift equal to 3x current baseline across the first 12 months (we can bake in prorated true-ups).
- Ramp credits: cap total onboarding credits at 10% of expected first-quarter ARR to protect margin.
- Auto-roll conversion condition is sensible but we should require three consecutive months at top band or ratchet to the 12-mo hold after customer signs the full amendment (reduces accidental roll-ins).
- Approve a one-time implementation credit but require clear activation metrics (token ingestion threshold + API health SLO).

Ben — can you draft the addendum language for a 90-day temporary pricehold and an auto-roll trigger? Lauren, do we want SRC (sales reserve credit) flexibility for internal approval?

Karthik
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy
From: Jules Martin <contracts@peregrinelabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@peregrinelabs.com>, Marcus Dobson <marcus.dobson@peregrinelabs.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Peregrine redlines + questions on auto-roll

Irene / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are Peregrine’s procurement redlines; legal is comfortable with a 90-day addendum if the following hold: 

1) The onboarding credit must be applied within the first invoice period and itemized;
2) The auto-roll must include a 30-day notice period and a cap on retroactive billing adjustments;
3) We need a single point of contact in Redwood for billing disputes.

We pushed back on the requirement for three months at the top band; our engineering lead prefers the two-month trigger because the new product line will go live in ~40 days. If you can accept a two-month proof but include a short notice window, we can sign faster.

Also, small ask from finance: can invoices be delivered to finance@peregrinelabs.com and include PO references?

Appreciate the partnership,
Jules
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jules Martin <contracts@peregrinelabs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine redlines + questions on auto-roll — updated addendum

Jules —

Thanks for the redlines — we reviewed with legal and finance. We can agree to the following compromise: 

- Onboarding credit: applied to first invoice, itemized as requested (we will show credit line item).
- Auto-roll: requires two consecutive months at the top band OR customer signature on the full amendment; we will provide 30 days’ notice prior to converting the temporary freeze into a 12-month pricehold. No retroactive upward billing adjustments — only future pricing applies.
- Billing contact: finance@peregrinelabs.com accepted; include PO reference field in invoices.

I’ve attached the updated SOW and the 90-day addendum with tracked changes (Peregrine-Redlines-090913.pdf). If this matches your procurement expectations we can route for signatures by next Tuesday.

Next steps: please confirm internal PO route and signatory. Once signed, onboarding team will schedule integration kickoff.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Peregrine-Redlines-090913.pdf
